location_description: Braintree (US:  ), officially the Town of Braintree, is a municipality in Norfolk County, Massachusetts, United States. Although officially known as a town,[2] Braintree is a city, with a mayor-council form of government, and is considered a city under Massachusetts law. The population was 39,143 at the 2020 census.
